record.scope: The 18 units in appliesTo (Silvally and its 17 type forms). All use the single class Silvally (catalog sharedClassWith), 3 stars, so the star index selects the same table entry. The form key does not change the strategy; the caster's types come from the class (NORMAL, ARTIFICIAL) plus types given by held items.
record.summary: Deals special damage to every enemy on the up-to-eight cells adjacent to the caster. The damage per enemy is a per-synergy-level amount (7, 10, 13, 20 by stars; 13 for the 3-star listed units) times the sum of the owner player's synergy values over the caster's current types. The cast target itself is not used for the damage (only enemies adjacent to the caster are hit). A caster without a player, or whose types have no synergy value, requests a raw 0 against each adjacent enemy, which is NOT a resolved 0: each unblocked enemy still takes 1.

targeting.who: all enemies (team !== caster team) on the cells returned by Board.getAdjacentCells around the caster; the cast target only triggers the cast
targeting.note: requiresTarget stays true (default), so the cast happens once an enemy is in range; an enemy that is the cast target but not adjacent (not possible at range 1 for these units) would not be hit. Pre-cast target selection was not traced.

geometry.shape: the 8 surrounding cells (3x3 minus centre), clipped to the board

effects.condition: every adjacent enemy, same raw amount

declaredRaw.multiplier: sum over the caster's types of player.synergies.get(type) (0 when missing); computed once at cast time

effects.scaling: raw = perSynergyLevel x synergyLevelsCount; AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); crit multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, needs ABILITY_CRIT), the same crit flag for all targets
effects.resolution: then each target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; blocked per target by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Raw zero is a request of zero, not a resolved zero. Traced (handleSpecialDamage pokemon-entity.ts:346-467 and handleDamage pokemon-state.ts:422-808; pinned-helper probe ZERO_RAW): neither has a damage <= 0 guard (only the Magic Bounce reflection tests damage > 0); AP, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, steam and crit factors leave 0 at 0; the SPE_DEF division gives 0; the non-TRUE reductions (Poke Doll x0.7, the GUTS / STURDY / DEFIANT / COACHING flat reductions, WONDER_GUARD) keep it at or below 0; then `reducedDamage = min(1)(Math.ceil(reducedDamage))` floors it at 1. So an unblocked, non-protected target takes 1 (HP 500 -> 499; on a shield the 1 lands on the shield; with flinch and a shield the ceil split gives 1 + 1); protect / skydiving / magicBounce still block it entirely and a zero never queues a bounce. The same request is made once per adjacent enemy, so with two adjacent enemies both take 1.

starBehavior.note: table [7, 10, 13, 20] indexed by stars - 1; all listed units are 3-star so the entry is 13.

record.positionalConditions: Only enemies on the caster's adjacent cells are hit; the number of hit enemies depends on the board at cast time. Synergy values come from the owner's board (bench units are not counted).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state; each cast recomputes from player.synergies and the entity's types, and spends maxPP of PP via the base process.
record.rawVsResolved: Raw damage per enemy = 13 x (sum of the owner's synergy values over the caster's types) for the listed units. The synergy values are counts of distinct families per type, not tier thresholds; with e.g. Normal 3 and Artificial 2 the multiplier is 5 and raw 65 before AP and SPE_DEF. Types added by held synergy items (Memory Discs) raise the multiplier by that type's count. A raw 0 (no player or no synergy value) resolves to 1 per unblocked adjacent enemy, not to 0.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, field multipliers) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: Whether pokemon.player is set for every simulation team (PVE, ghost/bot teams) was not traced; if it is absent the raw request is 0, which still resolves to 1 per unblocked adjacent enemy

How the Silvally forms (SILVALLY_BUG etc.) are produced and whether any of them change types: the catalog lists NORMAL, ARTIFICIAL for all, the form selection code (Silvally evolutionRule divergentEvolution near pokemon.ts line 10143) was not read
Memory Disc to type mapping (SynergyGivenByItem) was not read; only that held synergy items add their type through addSynergiesGivenByItems
Whether a unit's entity types are refreshed during a fight (types are copied at entity construction; later changes such as addType were not read)
The RKS_SYSTEM passive is a separate queue item; only its item-return behaviour was glimpsed and is not documented here
Whether the damage is also applied to the original cast target when it is not adjacent
The raw-zero trace was checked with a pinned-helper probe (the real handleSpecialDamage and handleDamage on stub units), not in a fight

evidence.note: base process spends maxPP of PP; default flags requiresTarget = true, canCritByDefault = false
crit is rolled only with ABILITY_CRIT or canCritByDefault; canCast false => no cast
protect / skydiving / magicBounce block ability damage
one class registered for Silvally and its 17 forms (catalog sharedClassWith); static types NORMAL, ARTIFICIAL; passive RKS_SYSTEM
each adjacent enemy gets the same raw damage, crit flag shared
8 surrounding cells, centre excluded, only cells on the board
held synergy items add their type to the board unit
item types added on each recompute; types of non-PROTEAN units are not cleared here
synergy values count distinct families on the board per type (bench units, positionY 0, are skipped)
moves items back to the player when the unit is moved to the bench (row 0)
handleDamage returns early only for a dead or resurrecting target and (as 0) for protect / skydiving; there is no damage <= 0 guard before the floor
non-TRUE flat reductions can push a zero below zero before the floor
only the Magic Bounce reflection tests damage > 0; the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block itself does not
